description: This Java class 'AttributesModelFactory' provides static factory methods for creating and validating 'Attributes' objects, including methods for creating empty, null, and initialized attributes, as well as validation of JSON pointers and objects related to attributes.

classes.name: AttributesModelFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create and validate Attributes objects.

methods.name: emptyAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new immutable empty Attributes object.

methods.name: nullAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new immutable Attributes object representing null.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Creates a new Attributes object initialized with a given JsonObject.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Creates a new Attributes object initialized with a JSON string.

methods.name: newAttributesBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for Attributes.

methods.name: newAttributesBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder initialized with a given JsonObject.

methods.name: validateAttributePointer
methods.description: Validates a JsonPointer for attribute keys.

methods.name: validateAttributeKeys
methods.description: Validates the keys of a JsonObject for attribute naming rules.
